advice: Abstain. The supplied evidence shows that three distinct active panel32 inner-loop changes have already been measured: moving pointer adds between FMOPA operations, pipelining next-step loads, and replacing SUB/CBNZ with SUBS/B.NE. Their ten-run results did not pass the fixed promotion gate. No other bounded, useful address-generation change is supported by the supplied source evidence without proposing a new index/layout or risking operand bounds.
risks: A new counter or pointer scheme would repeat the already-tested loop-control/address-generation ideas or require unverified changes to the active kernel. No new experiment or gain is established.
